ev.q: During 2009–2013, surveillance or notifiable disease data on typhoid cases were collected in 23 (48%) of 48 countries and areas
Overall, 23 (48%) of 48 countries and areas of SEAR and WPR collected data on typhoid cases.
typhoid vaccination or recommendation for use was reported by nine (19%) of 48 countries and areas
Nine (19%) countries reported implementation of typhoid vaccination programs or recommended vaccine use during 2009–2013.
Information on typhoid surveillance during 2009–2013 was obtained from a supplemental survey of surveillance officers and from published reports.
the status of typhoid surveillance and vaccine use in the 5-year period after the updated WHO recommendations was reviewed

methods_quotes.q: Information on typhoid surveillance during 2009–2013 was obtained from a supplemental survey of surveillance officers and from published reports.
The information available varied in detail, and might not represent current and comprehensive data for all countries reviewed.
